memoryBuilder.verseText: Jesus prayed: 'Father, not what I want — what You want.'

sequence.prompt: What happened in the garden? Put it in order.

items.label: They walked out to the olive garden
Jesus became very sad and troubled
He knelt and prayed to His Father
He stood up, because He had decided

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: Truly sad and truly trusting at once
He said honestly what He wanted
They let Him down, and He still loved them

application.question: Jesus told God exactly how He felt. What feeling could you tell God about today?
application.followUp: Being afraid is not the opposite of trusting God. Jesus was so sad He could hardly stand, and He trusted His Father completely at the very same moment. You can tell God the true thing and still say: not mine, but Yours.
